name: What questions should I ask about bathroom remodel warranties?

mainEntity.name: What questions should I ask about bathroom remodel warranties before hiring a contractor?
mainEntity.text: What questions should I ask about bathroom remodel warranties before hiring a contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: A warranty is only useful if you understand exactly what it covers. Before hiring, ask whether the warranty applies to labor, materials, or both, how long each part lasts, and what kinds of issues are excluded. You should also ask what maintenance is required to keep coverage valid, such as resealing, cleaning rules, or prompt reporting of leaks. For a bathroom remodel, the most important concerns usually involve tile, grout, waterproofing, plumbing connections, cabinetry, and finish hardware. A contractor should be able to explain how warranty claims are handled and how fast problems are typically addressed. Since bathrooms deal with water every day, a vague warranty is a risk. Written coverage helps distinguish contractors who stand behind their work from those who only offer general promises.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask what parts of the job are covered, how long coverage lasts, whether labor and materials are both included, and how warranty claims are handled. A good warranty should be written clearly and should explain exclusions, maintenance requirements, and who to contact if something fails.
